title: Nonnegative Einstein curvature classification in dimension four
exact_target: If a connected closed smooth Riemannian four-manifold has $Ric=3g$ and sectional curvature $\geq 0$, is its universal Riemannian cover isometric to the round $S^{4}$ of curvature 1, the Fubini–Study $CP^{2}$ normalized to $Ric=3g$, or $S^{2}(1/\surd 3)×S^{2}(1/\surd 3)$?
